comments.psp_seg: The port's fixed PSP paragraph (PC_PSP_SEG = 0x0800 in port/pc/pc.h).
comments.ds_seg: PSP + 0x10 MZ load paragraphs + DATA start/16 from the pinned TP 5.0 SAM.MAP.
comments.ss_seg: PSP + 0x10 MZ load paragraphs + STACK start/16 from SAM.MAP; agrees with MZ SS.
comments.sp: STACK length from SAM.MAP (16384 bytes from SAM.PAS $M); agrees with MZ SP.
comments.heap_org_seg: PSP + 0x10 MZ load paragraphs + HEAP start/16 from SAM.MAP.
comments.mem_top_seg: The existing port's conventional-memory ceiling, 0xA000; this is a platform policy, not inferred DATA.
